unusable_reason: Its heraldic stained-glass windows, the room's main feature, have no identified maker or date (the Cadw listing describes the glass but names neither), and the framed prints are unidentified. Masking the windows would leave a bare hall; the source is also outside the plan's approved accounts (Skokloster, Hallwyl, Riksantikvarieambetet).
